lines: If you're not washing your face with a cleansing brush, what are you doing?
Because using your hands leaves makeup and oil behind and towels just transfer bacteria right back into your skin.
This one has soft silicone bristles, five vibration settings, and a warming feature that heats up to 104 degrees so you can get that little extra spa feel.
And for something you do every single day, you might as well do it the right way.
Go grab yours in the orange cart before you forget about this.
